description: Presidential Secretariat - Amendment to the Gaz.Ex.No. 2068/01 of 23.04.2018 that Published to Summoned the Parliment
categorisation: This gazette content contains a correction to a presidential proclamation regarding the summoning of Parliament, which involves constitutional powers and legal procedures under Article 70 of the Constitution. It represents a legal/regulatory matter concerning the exercise of presidential authority and parliamentary procedures, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel or structural change.
